name: PROXY
description:
About This Game

FAST-PACED BULLET HELL COMBAT

Drop into a relentless, high-octane gauntlet where staying still means death. The action scales aggressively with every sector you clear, forcing you to constantly adapt your positioning, master the art of the dodge, and push your reflexes to the absolute limit in a non-stop, desperate struggle for survival.

INFINITE ITEM & WEAPON SYNERGIES

Arm yourself with a massive arsenal of devastating weaponry and game-changing utility items. Every piece of loot you discover alters the course of your run, stacking limitlessly to create chaotic, accidental combinations that turn you into a walking weapon of mass destruction. Experiment with dozens of weapons and stackable items to discover broken synergies, shattering the game's limits and turning the overwhelming forces to dust.

CHOOSE YOUR CHARACTER, BRING YOUR FRIENDS

Conquer the madness solo or squad up with friends to handle the frenzy together. Master a roster of completely unique characters, each sporting their own distinct specialized kit that drastically alter how you approach the combat. Coordinate with your team to blend your item builds, cover each other's blind spots, and discover the ultimate tactical synergies capable of dismantling the high-tech machine.
short_desc: Battle through a chaotic, high-tech alien world in this fast-paced top-down roguelike shooter – with friends or solo. Master intense bullet-hell combat and stack unique items to unleash devastating, game-breaking combos.
